# Harmonium

> Ship products, not utility classes. A complete React design system with typed components, design-token theming, and accessible defaults.

## Docs

- [Full API Reference](https://harmonium.revelry.co/llms-full.txt): Complete props, types, and usage examples for every component
- [GitHub](https://github.com/revelrylabs/harmonium): Source code and issue tracker
- [Storybook](https://harmonium.revelry.co): Interactive component demos

## Quick Start

Install: `npm install harmonium`
Import: `import { Button } from 'harmonium'`
Styles: `import 'harmonium/styles.css'`
Theme: Override `--harmonium-*` CSS custom properties

## Components

### Layout
- Stack: Vertical/horizontal flex layout with gap, align, justify
- Group: Horizontal flex with gap, align, justify, wrap, grow
- Grid + GridCol: CSS Grid layout with configurable columns and span
- Separator: Horizontal/vertical divider

### Forms
- Field + FieldLabel + FieldDescription + FieldError: Form field wrapper with auto-wired accessibility
- Input: Text input with size variants (sm/md/lg), Field-context-aware
- Textarea: Multi-line text input, Field-context-aware
- Select: Native select with size variants, Field-context-aware
- Checkbox: Checkbox with label
- Radio + RadioGroup: Radio buttons with fieldset grouping
- Switch: Toggle switch with label and size variants
- NumberInput: Numeric input with increment/decrement, Field-context-aware
- Slider: Range slider with size variants and optional value display
- Combobox: Searchable single-select dropdown
- MultiSelect: Tag-based multi-selection with search
- DatePicker: Date input, Field-context-aware
- TimePicker: Time input, Field-context-aware
- FileUpload: Drag-and-drop file upload zone

### Data Display
- Card + CardHeader + CardBody + CardFooter: Content container with elevated/outlined/filled variants
- Badge: Status label with semantic variants
- Alert: Dismissible notification banner
- Progress: Progress bar with variants and optional label
- Spinner: Loading indicator with size variants
- Avatar: User avatar with image and fallback
- Skeleton: Loading placeholder (text/circular/rectangular)
- Table + TableHead + TableBody + TableRow + TableHeader + TableCell: Semantic HTML table
- DataGrid: Sortable data table with column configuration

### Navigation
- Tabs + TabsList + TabsTrigger + TabsContent: Tabbed interface (controlled/uncontrolled)
- Accordion + AccordionItem + AccordionTrigger + AccordionContent: Expandable sections
- Breadcrumbs + BreadcrumbItem: Navigation breadcrumb trail
- Pagination: Page navigation with configurable visible pages
- TopBar + TopBarSection: Application header bar

### Overlays
- Dialog + DialogHeader + DialogBody + DialogFooter: Modal dialog with size variants
- Drawer: Slide-in panel from left or right
- Tooltip: Hover/focus tooltip with side positioning
- Popover: Click-triggered floating content
- Menu + MenuItem + MenuSeparator + MenuLabel: Dropdown menu
- CommandPalette: Command-K style searchable command list
- Toast (ToastProvider + useToast hook): Notification toast system
